episodes.synopsis: Yato continues his daily routine as a delivery god who also slays Phantoms when the need arises. Elsewhere, Bishamon is plagued by nightmares from times long past…
episodes.title: Bearing a Posthumous Name

episodes.synopsis: Yukine makes a new friend, but soon learns what it means to be a Regalia. Kazuma remains confused by Bishamon's declining health… until he makes a shocking discovery!
episodes.title: One of Her Memories

episodes.synopsis: Kugaha finally sets his plot into motion and has Kazuma banished. The ensuing chaos causes more pain for Bishamon… and pulls Yukine and Yato into the turmoil too!
episodes.title: False Bond

episodes.synopsis: Kazuma and Hiyori find themselve captured. They watch helplessly as Kugaha tricks Yato and Bishamon into battling each other to the death!
episodes.title: Wish

episodes.synopsis: Yukine shatters in half while Yato and Bishamon battle each other! Elsewhere, Kugaha enacts the second part of his plan by slaughtering Bishamon's Regalias!
episodes.title: Divine Acclamation, Imprecation

episodes.synopsis: Bishamon and Yato learn of Kugaha's betrayal, but most of the damage has already been done. Meanwhile, the giant, masked Phantom continues to hunt down the last remaining Regalias…
episodes.title: What Must Be Done

episodes.synopsis: Bishamon is forced to confer with the other gods about her recent failings. Elsewhere, Ebisu offers to buy Yukine from Yato for a large sum of money - enough for Yato to build his own shrine.
episodes.title: How to Worship a God

episodes.synopsis: After Kugaha's defeat, Ebisu decides to conduct certain, secret tests. Meanwhile, Yato reaches new highs and new lows after Hiyori gives him his own shrine…
episodes.title: God of Calamity

episodes.synopsis: Yato and Nora head into the underworld to complete one last job together: find and rescue a certain conjurer. But with each passing moment, Hiyori begins to forget Yato…
episodes.title: The Sound of a Thread Snapping

episodes.synopsis: The heavens are thrown into chaos when the gods learn that Ebisu has been experimenting with Phantoms. Meanwhile, Yato and Ebisu struggle to escape Izanami and leave the underworld behind.
episodes.title: A Certain Desire

episodes.synopsis: Bishamon and Hiyori manage to track down Yato, but they have no way of getting into the underworld. Meanwhile, Izanami continues to pursue Yato… And if he gets caught, he'll be stuck in the underworld forever!
episodes.title: Revival

episodes.synopsis: Bishamon faces Izanami in battle in order to save Yato. Yato's only hope for escape lies in his true name, but he's never revealed it to anyone. Meanwhile, the heavenly executioners have caught up with Ebisu and are prepared to kill him!
episodes.title: Your Voice Calls Out

episodes.synopsis: The heavens deliver their divine punishment, and Ebisu is forced to start anew. Despite this, Yato is filled with a new sense of purpose and upholds his promise to Ebisu.
episodes.title: The God of Fortune's Message
